settings.name: delay
settings.label: Delay in ms
settings.help: [Delay]||Delay after pageload before first beacon fires

settings.name: session_minutes
settings.label: Session minutes
settings.help: [Session]||Sliding expiry for beacon cookie, refreshed on each pageview||0 = browser session (ends when browser closes)

settings.name: collect_engagement
settings.label: Collect engagement
settings.help: [Engagement]||When yes, send scroll and time-on-page heartbeats

settings.name: cluster_keep_days
settings.label: Keep cluster info
settings.help: [Days]||How long to keep PHP-only 1-page location cluster rows (used to count bot-like cities)

settings.name: cluster_max_visits
settings.label: Max cluster bot visits
settings.help: [Count]||If more than this many PHP-only 1-page sessions share a city in the keep window, drop those sessions and ban the C-class

settings.name: cluster_max_coarse_visits
settings.label: Max cluster bot visits (country/region)
settings.help: [Count]||If country is set but region and/or city is empty: cap PHP-only 1-page sessions for that country or region. Does not include city-filled clusters. Same fail2ban log.

settings.name: show_geoip_debug
settings.label: GeoIP diagnostics
settings.help: [GeoIP diagnostics]||Show the GeoIP diagnostics block at the bottom of the analytics dashboard
